# PointerEventKind

[Framework](README.md) · `DotGame.Framework.Input` · enum

```csharp
public enum PointerEventKind
```

What a pointer event reports.

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| <a name="began"></a>`Began = 1` | A finger came down, or a button was pressed. |
| <a name="moved"></a>`Moved = 2` | It moved. A mouse moves with no button held too. |
| <a name="ended"></a>`Ended = 3` | A finger lifted, or a button was released. |
| <a name="canceled"></a>`Canceled = 4` | The press ended without acting: the game lost the focus or the system took over. Drop what it started. |
| <a name="wheel"></a>`Wheel = 5` | The wheel turned, by [`PointerEvent.ScrollWheelDelta`](PointerEvent.md#scrollwheeldelta), with the pointer where it is. |
